[[File:Espo_riot_gun.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Espo riot gun]]
A '''riot gun''' referred to any weapon that was designed to disable or otherwise knock organic beings unconscious. There were different varieties of riot guns that used [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blasts, concussion, chemicals, or other means to disable victims. Many types of riot guns had short barrels designed to combat multiple opponents, although some were modified to target a single opponent.

Examples of riot guns included the [[R-88 Suppressor riot rifle/Legends|R-88 Suppressor riot rifle]], used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which utilized [[Brix-C stun fluid/Legends|Brix-C stun fluid]] in an aerosol spray form to neutralize victims.<ref name="Rods">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021212caamas|text=Rods & Rifles: ''Coruscant and the Core Worlds'' Preview #6}}</ref> Another example was the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[500 riot gun/Legends|500 riot gun]] used by the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] Security Division, or [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]].<ref name="Gundark's">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> [[Imperial Dungeoneer]]s also used them.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Some known users of riot guns included the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], who used a [[Dengar's modified riot gun|modified version]] that could affect a single target with a more powerful blast.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Dengar's Modified Riot Gun}}</ref>
